surface_name: WP Mail SMTP, Email Test tool
title: WP Mail SMTP Email Test ignores Smart Routing rules
symptoms: Test email goes through the primary mailer although a routing rule should apply
cause: The Email Test tool always uses the primary mailer.
fix: Test routing with a real site email such as a password reset.
apply: Trigger a real email, then check WP Mail SMTP > Email Log for the mailer that sent it
